tasks.short: Review expenses, budgets, betting accounts and collections for accuracy.

steps.what: Retrieve actual operational expenses, budget versions, betting accounts and collection reports for the review period
Recalculate totals and compare account, budget and collection figures for the same periods and definitions
Investigate unmatched items with source evidence and responsible staff and judge whether the reviewed figures are accurate
outputs: supported review conclusions and unresolved exceptions

steps.what: Annotate and check the actual review findings, evidence references and unresolved accuracy exceptions
inputs: supported review conclusions and unresolved exceptions
outputs: checked final review annotations and internal review-file target

steps.what: Save the checked review annotations to the existing internal review file
inputs: checked final review annotations and internal review-file target

tasks.design: Test native period reports in the {ERP} and casino account system {OTHER}, then configure refreshable comparisons in the existing {SPREADSHEET} if needed. Calculate comparable totals deterministically, flag unmatched items and retain human investigation and final review annotations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Period and definition differences can make repeated comparisons cumbersome.
tasks.enabler_now: Native report filters and spreadsheet query and formula tools can reuse exact source definitions.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving timing differences, missing evidence and disputed explanations.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing when balanced totals still conceal an unsupported transaction.

ambition.what: Review unresolved collection differences before the next operating period closes.

tasks.altitude: Less calculation and retrieval, unchanged financial-control authority.

reach.task: Reconcile collection evidence to financial records
reach.learn: Preserve cutoffs, sign conventions and exception ownership.

evidence.claim: Native period reports and refreshable spreadsheet comparisons can reduce repeated retrieval and arithmetic.

assumptions: Boundary is accuracy review and its existing annotations. Correcting accounts, approving budgets, moving money and external reports are separate actions and receive no benefit here.

Finance and casino records owners produce period, transaction or account ID, amount, currency, sign, status and report revision. Budget owners produce the approved budget version. Paper or incomplete sources are captured and checked manually; missing items stay exceptions.
Test native reports first. Only compatible definitions are reconciled; no model judges accounting accuracy. Original annotations remain human and no new report is required.
The ordinary annotation check in s4 binds a1 to the finished findings and exact review file. Edits require rechecking; saving earns no benefit.
unknowns: Whether the existing reports already reconcile these sources.
Actual manual capture and cutoff mismatch rates.
research_questions: Can native reports preserve the comparison definitions and source revisions?

already_counted.description: Review recalculations and write and check actual review findings.

incremental.description: Maintain source definitions, queries and reconciliation checks.

approvals.approved_version: Final actual review annotations, source references and internal review-file target checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retrieval saves 11.25 points and recalculation 18; gross 29.25 less 1.5 upkeep. Low is no adoption if native reports already cover the comparison or sources remain manual.

tasks.short: Interview candidates and complete an authorized hire.

steps.what: Confirm the actual vacancy, required skills, authorized terms and hiring procedure
Review actual applications and prepare role-relevant interview questions
Interview candidates and capture actual answers and job-related evidence
Assess the actual interview evidence and select a candidate under the authorized hiring process
outputs: human selection decision and exact authorized offer terms

steps.what: Assemble the selected candidate's offer and required hiring documents from the approved terms
inputs: human selection decision and exact authorized offer terms

steps.what: Check the complete final offer, attachments, authorized terms and exact candidate destination
inputs: human selection decision and exact authorized offer terms
outputs: checked final offer package and candidate destination

steps.what: Send only the checked final offer package to the selected candidate
inputs: checked final offer package and candidate destination

steps.what: Verify the candidate's actual acceptance and required hiring conditions, resolving discrepancies with authorized staff
inputs: actual returned acceptance and condition evidence
outputs: verified actual acceptance and completed conditions

steps.what: Prepare and check the actual hire-status update with acceptance reference, conditions, start date and correct person record
inputs: verified actual acceptance and completed conditions
outputs: checked final hire-status update and exact person destination

steps.what: Commit the checked actual hire-status update to the authorized person record
inputs: checked final hire-status update and exact person destination

tasks.design: Configure the native {ATS} offer template to reuse a human-selected candidate and exact authorized terms. Keep application assessment, interviews, selection, acceptance verification and final checks human, with separate gates for the offer send and actual hire-status update.
tasks.previous_blocker: Approved terms may be copied repeatedly into offer documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Native field mapping can assemble known terms without ranking or selecting people.
tasks.still_hard: Fair candidate assessment and confirming actual hiring conditions.

ambition.what: No increase in automated candidate screening is proposed.

tasks.altitude: Less offer assembly; existing hiring authority remains unchanged.

reach.learn: Use approved terms and distinguish an offer from an accepted hire.

evidence.claim: Native recruitment templates can assemble human-approved offer fields without automating candidate selection.

assumptions: Boundary is the supervisor's hiring work. Candidate participation, HR checks and legal review are outside the focal denominator and receive no transferred saving. Existing hiring authorities remain required.

Authorized managers and HR produce vacancy ID, role, pay, hours, start date, required conditions and approved template version; the recruiter or candidate supplies verified identity and destination. Missing facts are manually confirmed before document assembly.
Try native {ATS} templates first. No model evaluates candidates or infers suitability. Interview capture remains counted in the full interview step; no transcription benefit is claimed.

a1 binds the finished offer and recipient checked in s6; a2 binds the actual accepted-status update checked in s9. An offer send does not establish acceptance. Edits void the relevant check; each ordinary action retains full effort.
unknowns: Current offer-template usage and delegated hiring authority.
Required external and HR conditions before recording a hire.
research_questions: Can native field reuse remove repeated offer typing while preserving all current checks?

already_counted.description: Review assembled offer fields and check the final package and actual hire update.

incremental.description: Maintain approved offer fields and template revisions.

approvals.approved_version: Complete final offer, attachments, exact approved terms and candidate destination checked in s6
Actual accepted hire-status update, evidence references, start date and exact person record checked in s9

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only 15 points of offer assembly fall to 60%, saving 6 less 1 upkeep. No adoption if the native template already populates the fields; no interview, selection or action saving.

tasks.short: Train, supervise, schedule and evaluate workers.

steps.what: Train actual workers in game procedures and service practices and check understanding
Supervise actual worker activity, coach and resolve floor coordination problems
outputs: actual supervision and observed work evidence

steps.what: Gather actual worker availability, required qualifications, contract limits and coverage requirements in the scheduler {OTHER}
Build the worker roster and staff notice from actual coverage needs and checked constraints in the scheduler {OTHER}
outputs: complete roster and exact staff notice draft

steps.what: Check the complete final roster, coverage, permitted hours, staff notice and exact worker recipients
inputs: complete roster and exact staff notice draft
outputs: checked final roster and exact staff notice package

steps.what: Commit the checked roster in the internal scheduler {OTHER}
inputs: checked final roster and exact staff notice package

steps.what: Send the checked roster notice to the exact affected workers through the scheduler {OTHER}
inputs: checked final roster and exact staff notice package

steps.what: Review actual work observations and agreed criteria for the worker evaluation
inputs: actual supervision and observed work evidence

steps.what: Evaluate the worker, discuss actual performance and agree appropriate support or improvement actions
outputs: human evaluation and actual agreed support actions

steps.what: Write and check the actual evaluation record, worker identity, evidence limits and agreed support actions
inputs: human evaluation and actual agreed support actions
outputs: checked final evaluation record and restricted worker destination

steps.what: Save the checked actual evaluation to the restricted worker record
inputs: checked final evaluation record and restricted worker destination

tasks.design: Configure native constraint checks and roster drafting in the staff scheduler {OTHER}, and reuse identity and review-period headers in {TALENT}. Keep training, floor supervision, performance judgement and actual evaluation wording human; roster commitment, staff notice and evaluation save each have a final-version gate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scheduling constraints and basic evaluation headers may be repeatedly entered.
tasks.enabler_now: Native availability, qualification and hours checks can support a roster without evaluating people.
tasks.still_hard: Coaching fairly and accommodating real coverage conflicts.
tasks.human_edge: Giving contextual feedback and responding to workers' concerns.

ambition.what: No automated worker rating or additional floor workload is proposed.

tasks.altitude: Slightly less roster assembly; supervisory rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Prepare a coverage roster under existing staffing rules
reach.learn: Distinguish hard constraints from staffing preferences.

evidence.claim: Native schedulers commonly use availability and hours constraints; record forms can reuse identity headers without generating employee evaluations.

assumptions: Boundary covers the supervisor's actual training, supervision, scheduling and evaluation work. Learners' time and HR work are outside the denominator; no saving is transferred to them. Existing separate training-completion records are not invented or credited here.

Workers supply actual availability; authorized HR records supply worker ID, qualifications, permitted hours and contract constraints; management supplies coverage needs. Missing fields are manually verified. Actual supervision evidence and evaluation language come only from the supervisor, not attendance-derived ratings.
Test native scheduling rules and {TALENT} forms first. No model ranks workers or infers performance. National working-time and consultation requirements must be confirmed locally.

a1 and a2 bind the finished roster and exact notice checked in s5, not a blank roster or future draft. a3 binds the complete actual evaluation checked during its authoring in s10. Changes void the relevant approval; ordinary commits and sends remain full time.
unknowns: Whether native scheduler constraints already remove the assembly work.
Current consultation arrangements and local scheduling rules.
research_questions: Can native constraint checking reduce roster effort without using inferred worker traits?

approvals.approved_version: Complete final roster, worker assignments, times and scheduler destination checked in s5
Exact final roster notice, roster revision and affected worker recipients checked in s5
Complete actual evaluation wording, worker identity, support actions and restricted record destination checked in s10
